snippet.title: Yerba Buena - Announcement Trailer - FGS Live From GDC 2026
snippet.description:
A World premiere trailer for upcoming mind-bending puzzle-platformer Yerba Buena. Use the power of the Oscillator to deconstruct and reconstruct the defunct and glitchy video game world in which you live! Yerba Buena is coming to PS5 / XBOX SERIES / PC on May 26th 2026

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2330110/Yerba_Buena

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
